   155→class RenderPlanner:
   156→    """Builds a RenderPlan from artist intent.
   157→
   158→    Uses the routing cascade to resolve complex intents and the recipe
   159→    registry for known patterns. Falls back to a default render handler
   160→    sequence when neither matches.
   161→
   162→    Args:
   163→        routing_cascade: Existing tiered routing system.
   164→        recipe_registry: Existing recipe registry for pattern matching.
   165→    """
   166→
   167→    def __init__(
   168→        self,
   169→        routing_cascade: Optional[RoutingCascade] = None,
   170→        recipe_registry: Optional[RecipeRegistry] = None,
   171→    ) -> None:
   172→        self._routing = routing_cascade
   173→        self._recipes = recipe_registry
   174→
   175→    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
   176→    # Public API
   177→    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
   178→
   179→    def plan(
   180→        self,
   181→        intent: str,
   182→        scene_context: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
   183→    ) -> RenderPlan:
   184→        """Parse intent into a full RenderPlan.
   185→
   186→        Steps:
   187→            1. Parse intent into structured parameters.
   188→            2. Try recipe registry for a known pattern.
   189→            3. Fall back to routing cascade or default sequence.
   190→            4. Attach standard validation checks.
   191→            5. Assign gate level based on intent kind.
   192→        """
   193→        parsed = _parse_intent(intent)
   194→        steps = self._resolve_steps(intent, parsed, scene_context)
   195→        gate = self._assign_gate(parsed)
   196→
   197→        return RenderPlan(
   198→            intent=intent,
   199→            steps=steps,
   200→            validation_checks=[
   201→                PreFlightCheck(
   202→                    name=c.name,
   203→                    description=c.description,
   204→                    severity=c.severity,
   205→                )
   206→                for c in _STANDARD_CHECKS
   207→            ],
   208→            estimated_frames=len(parsed["frames"]),
   209→            gate_level=gate,
   210→        )
   211→
   212→    def replan(
   213→        self,
   214→        original_plan: RenderPlan,
   215→        evaluation: SequenceEvaluation,
   216→    ) -> RenderPlan:
   217→        """Create a revised plan based on evaluation results.
   218→
   219→        Only re-renders failed frames and adjusts quality settings if
   220→        the evaluation flagged specific issues (fireflies, clipping, etc.).
   221→        """
   222→        failed_frames = [
   223→            fe.frame
   224→            for fe in evaluation.frame_evaluations
   225→            if not fe.passed
   226→        ]
   227→
   228→        if not failed_frames:
   229→            # Everything passed — nothing to replan
   230→            return original_plan
   231→
   232→        # Build re-render intent
   233→        frames_str = ", ".join(str(f) for f in sorted(failed_frames))
   234→        replan_intent = f"re-render frames {frames_str}"
   235→        parsed = _parse_intent(replan_intent)
   236→
   237→        # Collect issue-based parameter adjustments
   238→        adjustments = self._adjustments_from_evaluation(evaluation)
   239→
   240→        steps = self._build_render_steps(parsed, adjustments)
   241→
   242→        return RenderPlan(
   243→            intent=replan_intent,
   244→            steps=steps,
   245→            validation_checks=[
   246→                PreFlightCheck(
   247→                    name=c.name,
   248→                    description=c.description,
   249→                    severity=c.severity,
   250→                )
   251→                for c in _STANDARD_CHECKS
   252→            ],
   253→            estimated_frames=len(failed_frames),
   254→            gate_level=GateLevel.INFORM,  # Re-renders are lower gate
   255→        )
   256→
   257→    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
   258→    # Internal helpers
   259→    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
   260→
   261→    def _resolve_steps(
   262→        self,
   263→        intent: str,
   264→        parsed: Dict[str, Any],
   265→        scene_context: Optional[Dict[str, Any]],
   266→    ) -> List[RenderStep]:
   267→        """Try recipe -> routing -> default fallback."""
   268→        # 1. Try recipe registry
   269→        if self._recipes is not None:
   270→            recipe = self._recipes.match(intent)
   271→            if recipe is not None:
   272→                return self._steps_from_recipe(recipe, parsed)
   273→
   274→        # 2. Try routing cascade
   275→        if self._routing is not None:
   276→            try:
   277→                result = self._routing.route(intent, scene_context)
   278→                if result and hasattr(result, "steps"):
   279→                    return self._steps_from_routing(result, parsed)
   280→            except Exception:
   281→                pass  # Fall through to default
   282→
   283→        # 3. Default render sequence
   284→        return self._build_render_steps(parsed)
   285→
   286→    def _steps_from_recipe(
   287→        self,
   288→        recipe: Any,
   289→        parsed: Dict[str, Any],
   290→    ) -> List[RenderStep]:
   291→        """Convert a matched recipe into RenderSteps."""
   292→        steps: List[RenderStep] = []
   293→        if hasattr(recipe, "steps"):
   294→            for rs in recipe.steps:
   295→                action = rs.action if hasattr(rs, "action") else str(rs)
   296→                payload = rs.payload_template if hasattr(rs, "payload_template") else {}
   297→                gate = GateLevel.INFORM
   298→                if hasattr(rs, "gate_level"):
   299→                    gate = GateLevel(rs.gate_level.value)
   300→                steps.append(RenderStep(
   301→                    handler=action,
   302→                    params={**payload, "start": parsed["start"], "end": parsed["end"]},
   303→                    description=f"Recipe step: {action}",
   304→                    gate=gate,
   305→                ))
   306→        return steps or self._build_render_steps(parsed)
   307→
   308→    def _steps_from_routing(
   309→        self,
   310→        result: Any,
   311→        parsed: Dict[str, Any],
   312→    ) -> List[RenderStep]:
   313→        """Convert routing cascade result into RenderSteps."""
   314→        steps: List[RenderStep] = []
   315→        if hasattr(result, "steps"):
   316→            for step in result.steps:
   317→                handler = step.action if hasattr(step, "action") else str(step)
   318→                params = step.payload if hasattr(step, "payload") else {}
   319→                steps.append(RenderStep(
   320→                    handler=handler,
   321→                    params={**params, "start": parsed["start"], "end": parsed["end"]},
   322→                    description=f"Routed step: {handler}",
   323→                    gate=GateLevel.INFORM,
   324→                ))
   325→        return steps or self._build_render_steps(parsed)
   326→
   327→    def _build_render_steps(
   328→        self,
   329→        parsed: Dict[str, Any],
   330→        adjustments: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
   331→    ) -> List[RenderStep]:
   332→        """Build the default render handler sequence.
   333→
   334→        Default pipeline:
   335→            1. validate_frame (pre-check)
   336→            2. render_settings (apply quality)
   337→            3. render_sequence (actual render)
   338→        """
   339→        adj = adjustments or {}
   340→        steps: List[RenderStep] = []
   341→
   342→        # Step 1: Validate the stage before rendering
   343→        steps.append(RenderStep(
   344→            handler="validate_frame",
   345→            params={"frame": parsed["start"]},
   346→            description="Pre-render frame validation",
   347→            gate=GateLevel.INFORM,
   348→        ))
   349→
   350→        # Step 2: Apply render settings if adjustments needed
   351→        if adj:
   352→            steps.append(RenderStep(
   353→                handler="render_settings",
   354→                params=adj,
   355→                description="Apply adjusted render settings",
   356→                gate=GateLevel.INFORM,
   357→            ))
   358→
   359→        # Step 3: Render
   360→        render_params: Dict[str, Any] = {
   361→            "start_frame": parsed["start"],
   362→            "end_frame": parsed["end"],
   363→        }
   364→        if parsed["kind"] == "rerender":
   365→            render_params["frames"] = parsed["frames"]
   366→        if parsed["kind"] == "turntable":
   367→            render_params["turntable"] = True
   368→
   369→        steps.append(RenderStep(
   370→            handler="render_sequence",
   371→            params=render_params,
   372→            description=f"Render frames {parsed['start']}-{parsed['end']}",
   373→            gate=GateLevel.REVIEW,
   374→        ))
   375→
   376→        return steps
   377→
   378→    def _assign_gate(self, parsed: Dict[str, Any]) -> GateLevel:
   379→        """Assign overall gate level based on intent kind."""
   380→        if parsed["kind"] == "rerender":
   381→            return GateLevel.INFORM
   382→        if parsed["kind"] == "turntable":
   383→            return GateLevel.REVIEW
   384→        if len(parsed["frames"]) > 100:
   385→            return GateLevel.CONFIRM
   386→        return GateLevel.REVIEW
   387→
   388→    def _adjustments_from_evaluation(
   389→        self,
   390→        evaluation: SequenceEvaluation,
   391→    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
   392→        """Derive render setting adjustments from evaluation issues."""
   393→        adjustments: Dict[str, Any] = {}
   394→
   395→        all_issues: List[str] = []
   396→        for fe in evaluation.frame_evaluations:
   397→            all_issues.extend(fe.issues)
   398→        all_issues.extend(evaluation.temporal_issues)
   399→
   400→        if any("firefly" in i.lower() or "fireflies" in i.lower() for i in all_issues):
   401→            adjustments["pixel_samples"] = 128
   402→            adjustments["clamp_indirect"] = 10.0
   403→
   404→        if any("clipping" in i.lower() for i in all_issues):
   405→            adjustments["exposure_compensation"] = -0.5
   406→
   407→        if any("flicker" in i.lower() for i in all_issues):
   408→            adjustments["pixel_samples"] = max(
   409→                adjustments.get("pixel_samples", 64), 96
   410→            )
   411→
   412→        return adjustments
   413→

1→"""
     2→Synapse Autonomy Pipeline — Autonomous Driver
     3→
     4→Orchestrates the full render loop: Plan -> Validate -> Execute -> Evaluate -> Report.
     5→Supports checkpoint/resume, decision logging, gate-based approval, and
     6→automatic re-planning on evaluation failure (up to max_iterations).
     7→"""
     8→
     9→import asyncio
    10→import json
    11→import logging
    12→import time
    13→from datetime import datetime
    14→from typing import Any, Callable, Dict, List, Optional, Protocol
    15→
    16→from .models import (
    17→    CheckSeverity,
    18→    Decision,
    19→    GateLevel,
    20→    RenderPlan,
    21→    RenderReport,
    22→    RenderStep,
    23→    SequenceEvaluation,
    24→    StepStatus,
    25→)
    26→from .planner import RenderPlanner
    27→from .validator import PreFlightValidator
    28→from .evaluator import RenderEvaluator
    29→
    30→logger = logging.getLogger("synapse.autonomy.driver")

    33→class HandlerInterface(Protocol):
    34→    """Async callable interface for executing MCP handler tools."""
    35→
    36→    async def call(self, tool_name: str, params: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    37→        """Call a handler tool by name with the given parameters."""
    38→        ...

    49→class AutonomousDriver:
    50→    """Drives the full autonomous render loop.
    51→
    52→    Lifecycle per execution:
    53→        1. Plan: build a RenderPlan from artist intent
    54→        2. Gate: present plan for approval if gate level >= REVIEW
    55→        3. Validate: run pre-flight checks (HARD_FAIL stops, SOFT_WARN continues)
    56→        4. Execute: call render handler(s) via handler_interface
    57→        5. Evaluate: run quality checks on rendered output
    58→        6. Re-plan: if evaluation fails and iterations < max, loop back
    59→        7. Report: compile final RenderReport
    60→
    61→    Args:
    62→        planner: Builds and revises render plans.
    63→        validator: Runs pre-flight scene checks.
    64→        evaluator: Evaluates rendered output quality.
    65→        handler_interface: Async callable for MCP handler tools.
    66→        memory_system: For persisting decisions and context.
    67→        max_iterations: Maximum re-plan attempts before giving up.
    68→    """
    69→
    70→    def __init__(
    71→        self,
    72→        planner: RenderPlanner,
    73→        validator: PreFlightValidator,
    74→        evaluator: RenderEvaluator,
    75→        handler_interface: HandlerInterface,
    76→        memory_system: Optional[MemorySystem] = None,
    77→        max_iterations: int = 3,
    78→    ) -> None:
    79→        self._planner = planner
    80→        self._validator = validator
    81→        self._evaluator = evaluator
    82→        self._handler = handler_interface
    83→        self._memory = memory_system
    84→        self._max_iterations = max_iterations
    85→
    86→        self._decisions: List[Decision] = []
    87→        self._checkpoints: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
    88→        self._cancelled = False
    89→
    90→        # Approval callback — override for UI integration
    91→        self._approval_callback: Optional[Callable[[RenderPlan], bool]] = None
    92→
    93→    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    94→    # Public API
    95→    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    96→
    97→    async def execute(self, intent: str) -> RenderReport:
    98→        """Run the full autonomous render loop.
    99→
   100→        Args:
   101→            intent: Natural-language render intent from the artist.
   102→
   103→        Returns:
   104→            RenderReport with plan, evaluation, decisions, and success flag.
   105→        """
   106→        start_time = time.monotonic()
   107→        self._cancelled = False
   108→        self._decisions = []
   109→        iteration = 0
   110→        evaluation: Optional[SequenceEvaluation] = None
   111→
   112→        # Step 1: Plan
   113→        plan = self._planner.plan(intent)
   114→        self._log_decision(
   115→            context="initial_plan",
   116→            decision=f"Created render plan with {len(plan.steps)} step(s) "
   117→                     f"for {plan.estimated_frames} frame(s)",
   118→            reasoning=f"Parsed intent: '{intent}'",
   119→            gate=GateLevel.INFORM,
   120→        )
   121→        self._checkpoint("plan_created", {"plan_intent": plan.intent})
   122→
   123→        # Step 2: Gate check
   124→        if plan.gate_level in (GateLevel.REVIEW, GateLevel.CONFIRM):
   125→            approved = await self._present_for_approval(plan)
   126→            if not approved:
   127→                self._log_decision(
   128→                    context="gate_rejected",
   129→                    decision="Artist declined the render plan",
   130→                    reasoning="Plan was presented for approval and rejected",
   131→                    gate=plan.gate_level,
   132→                )
   133→                return RenderReport(
   134→                    plan=plan,
   135→                    decisions=list(self._decisions),
   136→                    iterations=0,
   137→                    total_time_seconds=time.monotonic() - start_time,
   138→                    success=False,
   139→                )
   140→
   141→        while iteration < self._max_iterations:
   142→            if self._cancelled:
   143→                self._log_decision(
   144→                    context="emergency_stop",
   145→                    decision="Render loop cancelled via emergency stop",
   146→                    reasoning="emergency_stop() was called during execution",
   147→                    gate=GateLevel.INFORM,
   148→                )
   149→                break
   150→
   151→            iteration += 1
   152→            self._checkpoint(f"iteration_{iteration}", {"iteration": iteration})
   153→
   154→            # Step 3: Validate
   155→            checks = await self._validator.validate(plan)
   156→            plan.validation_checks = checks
   157→
   158→            hard_fails = [c for c in checks if c.severity == CheckSeverity.HARD_FAIL and not c.passed]
   159→            soft_warns = [c for c in checks if c.severity == CheckSeverity.SOFT_WARN and not c.passed]
   160→
   161→            if hard_fails:
   162→                fail_names = ", ".join(c.name for c in hard_fails)
   163→                self._log_decision(
   164→                    context="validation_failed",
   165→                    decision=f"Stopping: {len(hard_fails)} hard failure(s): {fail_names}",
   166→                    reasoning="; ".join(c.message for c in hard_fails),
   167→                    gate=GateLevel.INFORM,
   168→                )
   169→                return RenderReport(
   170→                    plan=plan,
   171→                    decisions=list(self._decisions),
   172→                    iterations=iteration,
   173→                    total_time_seconds=time.monotonic() - start_time,
   174→                    success=False,
   175→                )
   176→
   177→            if soft_warns:
   178→                warn_names = ", ".join(c.name for c in soft_warns)
   179→                self._log_decision(
   180→                    context="validation_warnings",
   181→                    decision=f"Continuing with {len(soft_warns)} warning(s): {warn_names}",
   182→                    reasoning="Soft warnings don't block execution",
   183→                    gate=GateLevel.INFORM,
   184→                )
   185→
   186→            # Step 4: Execute render steps
   187→            execution_ok = await self._execute_steps(plan)
   188→            if not execution_ok:
   189→                self._log_decision(
   190→                    context="execution_failed",
   191→                    decision="One or more render steps failed",
   192→                    reasoning="Handler returned an error during execution",
   193→                    gate=GateLevel.INFORM,
   194→                )
   195→                if iteration < self._max_iterations:
   196→                    # Build a minimal evaluation so replan has something to work with
   197→                    if evaluation is None:
   198→                        evaluation = SequenceEvaluation(passed=False)
   199→                    plan = self._planner.replan(plan, evaluation)
   200→                    continue
   201→                break
   202→
   203→            # Step 5: Collect render results and evaluate
   204→            render_results = await self._collect_results(plan)
   205→            evaluation = self._evaluator.evaluate_sequence(render_results)
   206→
   207→            self._log_decision(
   208→                context="evaluation_complete",
   209→                decision=f"Sequence score: {evaluation.overall_score:.2f}, "
   210→                         f"passed: {evaluation.passed}",
   211→                reasoning=f"{len(evaluation.frame_evaluations)} frame(s) evaluated, "
   212→                          f"{len(evaluation.temporal_issues)} temporal issue(s)",
   213→                gate=GateLevel.INFORM,
   214→            )
   215→
   216→            # Step 6: Check if we need to re-plan
   217→            if evaluation.passed:
   218→                self._log_decision(
   219→                    context="render_success",
   220→                    decision="Render sequence passed quality checks",
   221→                    reasoning=f"Overall score {evaluation.overall_score:.2f} >= 0.7 threshold",
   222→                    gate=GateLevel.INFORM,
   223→                )
   224→                break
   225→
   226→            if iteration < self._max_iterations:
   227→                self._log_decision(
   228→                    context="replan",
   229→                    decision=f"Re-planning (iteration {iteration}/{self._max_iterations})",
   230→                    reasoning="Evaluation failed — adjusting settings and re-rendering failed frames",
   231→                    gate=GateLevel.INFORM,
   232→                )
   233→                plan = self._planner.replan(plan, evaluation)
   234→            else:
   235→                self._log_decision(
   236→                    context="max_iterations",
   237→                    decision=f"Giving up after {self._max_iterations} iteration(s)",
   238→                    reasoning="Max iteration limit reached without passing quality checks",
   239→                    gate=GateLevel.INFORM,
   240→                )
   241→
   242→        total_time = time.monotonic() - start_time
   243→
   244→        # Step 7: Compile report
   245→        report = RenderReport(
   246→            plan=plan,
   247→            evaluation=evaluation,
   248→            decisions=list(self._decisions),
   249→            iterations=iteration,
   250→            total_time_seconds=total_time,
   251→            success=evaluation.passed if evaluation else False,
   252→        )
   253→
   254→        # Persist to memory
   255→        if self._memory:
   256→            try:
   257→                self._memory.add(
   258→                    content=f"Autonomous render: '{intent}' - "
   259→                            f"{'succeeded' if report.success else 'failed'} "
   260→                            f"after {iteration} iteration(s) in {total_time:.1f}s",
   261→                    type="decision",
   262→                    tags=["autonomy", "render"],
   263→                )
   264→            except Exception:
   265→                logger.warning("Couldn't persist render report to memory")
   266→
   267→        return report
   268→
   269→    def emergency_stop(self) -> None:
   270→        """Cancel the current render loop at the next checkpoint.
   271→
   272→        Also attempts to cancel any active TOPS work items via the
   273→        handler interface.
   274→        """
   275→        self._cancelled = True
   276→        self._log_decision(
   277→            context="emergency_stop_requested",
   278→            decision="Emergency stop requested by artist",
   279→            reasoning="Artist triggered emergency stop",
   280→            gate=GateLevel.INFORM,
   281→        )
   282→        logger.warning("Emergency stop requested — render loop will halt at next checkpoint")
   283→
   284→    def set_approval_callback(self, callback: Callable[[RenderPlan], bool]) -> None:
   285→        """Set a callback for gate approval prompts.
   286→
   287→        The callback receives a RenderPlan and returns True to approve,
   288→        False to reject. If no callback is set, plans at REVIEW level
   289→        are auto-approved and CONFIRM level plans are auto-rejected.
   290→        """
   291→        self._approval_callback = callback
   292→
   293→    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
   294→    # Internal: execution
   295→    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
   296→
   297→    async def _execute_steps(self, plan: RenderPlan) -> bool:
   298→        """Execute all steps in the plan sequentially.
   299→
   300→        Returns True if all steps completed, False if any failed.
   301→        """
   302→        for step in plan.steps:
   303→            if self._cancelled:
   304→                step.status = StepStatus.SKIPPED
   305→                continue
   306→
   307→            step.status = StepStatus.RUNNING
   308→            try:
   309→                result = await self._handler.call(step.handler, step.params)
   310→                step.result = result
   311→                step.status = StepStatus.COMPLETED
   312→            except Exception as exc:
   313→                step.error = str(exc)
   314→                step.status = StepStatus.FAILED
   315→                logger.error(
   316→                    "Step '%s' failed: %s", step.description, exc
   317→                )
   318→                return False
   319→
   320→        return True
   321→
   322→    async def _collect_results(
   323→        self,
   324→        plan: RenderPlan,
   325→    ) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
   326→        """Collect rendered frame data for evaluation.
   327→
   328→        Queries the handler_interface for render output paths and
   329→        optionally loads image data if available.
   330→        """
   331→        results: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
   332→
   333→        # Find the render step to get frame range
   334→        render_step = None
   335→        for step in plan.steps:
   336→            if step.handler in ("render_sequence", "render"):
   337→                render_step = step
   338→                break
   339→
   340→        if render_step is None or render_step.result is None:
   341→            return results
   342→
   343→        # Extract output info from render result
   344→        output_frames = render_step.result.get("frames", [])
   345→        if isinstance(output_frames, list):
   346→            for frame_info in output_frames:
   347→                if isinstance(frame_info, dict):
   348→                    results.append({
   349→                        "frame": frame_info.get("frame", 0),
   350→                        "output_path": frame_info.get("output_path", ""),
   351→                        "image_data": frame_info.get("image_data"),
   352→                    })
   353→                elif isinstance(frame_info, (int, float)):
   354→                    results.append({
   355→                        "frame": int(frame_info),
   356→                        "output_path": render_step.result.get("output_dir", ""),
   357→                        "image_data": None,
   358→                    })
   359→
   360→        # If no structured frame data, build from step params
   361→        if not results and render_step.result:
   362→            start = render_step.params.get("start_frame", 1)
   363→            end = render_step.params.get("end_frame", start)
   364→            output_dir = render_step.result.get("output_dir", "")
   365→            for f in range(start, end + 1):
   366→                results.append({
   367→                    "frame": f,
   368→                    "output_path": output_dir,
   369→                    "image_data": None,
   370→                })
   371→
   372→        return results
   373→
   374→    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
   375→    # Internal: gate system
   376→    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
   377→
   378→    async def _present_for_approval(self, plan: RenderPlan) -> bool:
   379→        """Present a plan for artist approval.
   380→
   381→        Uses the registered approval callback if available. Otherwise:
   382→        - REVIEW plans are auto-approved (artist trusts the system)
   383→        - CONFIRM plans are auto-rejected (too risky without explicit approval)
   384→        """
   385→        if self._approval_callback is not None:
   386→            try:
   387→                return self._approval_callback(plan)
   388→            except Exception as exc:
   389→                logger.error("Approval callback raised an error: %s", exc)
   390→                return False
   391→
   392→        # Default policy
   393→        if plan.gate_level == GateLevel.REVIEW:
   394→            self._log_decision(
   395→                context="auto_approve",
   396→                decision="Auto-approved REVIEW-level plan (no approval callback set)",
   397→                reasoning="Default policy: REVIEW plans proceed without explicit approval",
   398→                gate=GateLevel.REVIEW,
   399→            )
   400→            return True
   401→
   402→        # CONFIRM requires explicit approval
   403→        self._log_decision(
   404→            context="auto_reject",
   405→            decision="Auto-rejected CONFIRM-level plan (no approval callback set)",
   406→            reasoning="Default policy: CONFIRM plans require an explicit approval callback",
   407→            gate=GateLevel.CONFIRM,
   408→        )
   409→        return False
   410→
   411→    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
   412→    # Internal: checkpoint / resume
   413→    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
   414→
   415→    def _checkpoint(self, step: str, state: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
   416→        """Save a checkpoint for potential resume.
   417→
   418→        Checkpoints are in-memory for now. Phase 3 will persist to disk.
   419→        """
   420→        self._checkpoints[step] = {
   421→            "timestamp": time.time(),
   422→            "state": state,
   423→            "decisions_count": len(self._decisions),
   424→        }
   425→        logger.debug("Checkpoint saved: %s", step)
   426→
   427→    def _resume(self, checkpoint_id: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
   428→        """Resume from a saved checkpoint.
   429→
   430→        Returns the checkpoint state dict or None if not found.
   431→        """
   432→        cp = self._checkpoints.get(checkpoint_id)
   433→        if cp is None:
   434→            logger.warning("Couldn't find checkpoint '%s' to resume from", checkpoint_id)
   435→            return None
   436→        logger.info("Resuming from checkpoint '%s'", checkpoint_id)
   437→        return cp.get("state")
   438→
   439→    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
   440→    # Internal: decision logging
   441→    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
   442→
   443→    def _log_decision(
   444→        self,
   445→        context: str,
   446→        decision: str,
   447→        reasoning: str,
   448→        gate: GateLevel,
   449→    ) -> None:
   450→        """Record a decision made during the autonomous loop."""
   451→        d = Decision(
   452→            timestamp=datetime.now(),
   453→            context=context,
   454→            decision=decision,
   455→            reasoning=reasoning,
   456→            gate_level=gate,
   457→        )
   458→        self._decisions.append(d)
   459→        logger.info("[%s] %s — %s", context, decision, reasoning)
   460→

| Module | Current Role | Prediction Hook | Verification Hook |
|--------|--------------|-----------------|-------------------|
| **validator** | Pre-flight checks (8 async) | Input: camera, prims, settings | N/A |

| **evaluator** | Measure actual quality | N/A | Output: metrics for verify |
| **driver** | Orchestrate loop | Call predictor after validate | Call verifier after evaluate |

"""
Synapse Autonomy Pipeline — Data Models

Shared data structures for the autonomous render loop:
Plan -> Validate -> Execute -> Evaluate -> Report.

All models are stdlib-only dataclasses with full type hints.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from enum import Enum
from typing import List, Optional, Dict, Any
from datetime import datetime


class GateLevel(Enum):
    """Approval requirement for an autonomous step.

    Mirrors core.gates.GateLevel but scoped to the autonomy pipeline
    to avoid tight coupling. Maps 1:1 when bridging to the gate system.
    """
    INFORM = "inform"
    REVIEW = "review"
    CONFIRM = "confirm"


class StepStatus(Enum):
    """Execution status of a single render step."""
    PENDING = "pending"
    RUNNING = "running"
    COMPLETED = "completed"
    FAILED = "failed"
    SKIPPED = "skipped"


class CheckSeverity(Enum):
    """How severely a pre-flight check failure affects the pipeline."""
    HARD_FAIL = "hard_fail"   # Blocks execution entirely
    SOFT_WARN = "soft_warn"   # Logs warning, continues
    INFO = "info"             # Informational only


@dataclass
class RenderStep:
    """A single step in a render plan, mapped to a handler call."""
    handler: str
    params: Dict[str, Any]
    description: str
    gate: GateLevel = GateLevel.INFORM
    status: StepStatus = StepStatus.PENDING
    result: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
    error: Optional[str] = None


@dataclass
class PreFlightCheck:
    """Result of a single pre-flight validation check."""
    name: str
    description: str
    severity: CheckSeverity
    passed: bool = False
    message: str = ""


@dataclass
class RenderPlan:
    """A complete render plan with steps and validation metadata."""
    intent: str
    steps: List[RenderStep] = field(default_factory=list)
    validation_checks: List[PreFlightCheck] = field(default_factory=list)
    estimated_frames: int = 0
    gate_level: GateLevel = GateLevel.REVIEW
    created_at: datetime = field(default_factory=datetime.now)


@dataclass
class FrameEvaluation:
    """Quality evaluation for a single rendered frame."""
    frame: int
    output_path: str
    passed: bool
    issues: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    metrics: Dict[str, float] = field(default_factory=dict)


@dataclass
class SequenceEvaluation:
    """Quality evaluation for an entire rendered sequence."""
    frame_evaluations: List[FrameEvaluation] = field(default_factory=list)
    temporal_issues: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    overall_score: float = 0.0
    passed: bool = False


@dataclass
class Decision:
    """A recorded decision made during the autonomous loop."""
    timestamp: datetime
    context: str
    decision: str
    reasoning: str
    gate_level: GateLevel


@dataclass
class RenderReport:
    """Final report from an autonomous render execution."""
    plan: RenderPlan
    evaluation: Optional[SequenceEvaluation] = None
    decisions: List[Decision] = field(default_factory=list)
    iterations: int = 0
    total_time_seconds: float = 0.0
    success: bool = False

class HandlerInterface(Protocol):
    """Async callable interface for querying scene state via MCP handlers."""

    async def call(self, tool_name: str, params: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Call a handler tool by name with the given parameters."""
        ...


class PreFlightValidator:
    """Runs all pre-flight checks against a RenderPlan.

    Each check queries the scene through the handler_interface and returns
    a PreFlightCheck result. All checks run concurrently via asyncio.gather
    and none short-circuit on failure.

    Args:
        handler_interface: Async callable for scene queries.
    """

    def __init__(self, handler_interface: HandlerInterface) -> None:
        self._handler = handler_interface

    async def validate(self, plan: RenderPlan) -> List[PreFlightCheck]:
        """Run all 8 pre-flight checks and return results.

        Does NOT short-circuit — all checks execute regardless of earlier
        failures so the artist gets a complete diagnostic.
        """
        checks = await asyncio.gather(
            self._check_camera(),
            self._check_renderable_prims(),
            self._check_materials(),
            self._check_render_settings(plan),
            self._check_frame_range(plan),
            self._check_output_path(),
            self._check_solaris_ordering(plan),
            self._check_missing_assets(),
            return_exceptions=True,
        )

        results: List[PreFlightCheck] = []
        for check in checks:
            if isinstance(check, PreFlightCheck):
                results.append(check)
            elif isinstance(check, Exception):
                # An individual check crashed — report as a soft warning
                results.append(PreFlightCheck(
                    name="internal_error",
                    description="A pre-flight check raised an unexpected error",
                    severity=CheckSeverity.SOFT_WARN,
                    passed=False,
                    message=f"Check failed internally: {check}",
                ))
        return results

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Individual checks
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    async def _check_camera(self) -> PreFlightCheck:
        """HARD_FAIL if no render camera exists on the USD stage."""
        try:
            result = await self._handler.call("get_stage_info", {})
            cameras = result.get("cameras", [])
            if not cameras:
                return PreFlightCheck(
                    name="camera",
                    description="Verify a render camera exists on the USD stage",
                    severity=CheckSeverity.HARD_FAIL,
                    passed=False,
                    message="Couldn't find a render camera on the stage. "
                            "Add a Camera LOP before rendering.",
                )
            return PreFlightCheck(
                name="camera",
                description="Verify a render camera exists on the USD stage",
                severity=CheckSeverity.HARD_FAIL,
                passed=True,
                message=f"Found {len(cameras)} camera(s): {', '.join(cameras[:5])}",
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            return PreFlightCheck(
                name="camera",
                description="Verify a render camera exists on the USD stage",
                severity=CheckSeverity.HARD_FAIL,
                passed=False,
                message=f"Couldn't query stage for cameras: {exc}",
            )

    async def _check_renderable_prims(self) -> PreFlightCheck:
        """HARD_FAIL if no renderable geometry prims exist."""
        try:
            result = await self._handler.call("get_stage_info", {})
            prim_count = result.get("prim_count", 0)
            renderable = result.get("renderable_prims", prim_count)
            if renderable == 0:
                return PreFlightCheck(
                    name="renderable_prims",
                    description="Verify at least one renderable geometry prim exists",
                    severity=CheckSeverity.HARD_FAIL,
                    passed=False,
                    message="Couldn't find any renderable geometry on the stage. "
                            "We need at least one mesh or other renderable prim.",
                )
            return PreFlightCheck(
                name="renderable_prims",
                description="Verify at least one renderable geometry prim exists",
                severity=CheckSeverity.HARD_FAIL,
                passed=True,
                message=f"Found {renderable} renderable prim(s) on the stage.",
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            return PreFlightCheck(
                name="renderable_prims",
                description="Verify at least one renderable geometry prim exists",
                severity=CheckSeverity.HARD_FAIL,
                passed=False,
                message=f"Couldn't query stage for renderable prims: {exc}",
            )

    async def _check_materials(self) -> PreFlightCheck:
        """SOFT_WARN if geometry prims lack assigned materials."""
        try:
            result = await self._handler.call("get_stage_info", {})
            unassigned = result.get("unassigned_material_prims", [])
            if unassigned:
                paths = ", ".join(str(p) for p in unassigned[:5])
                suffix = f" (and {len(unassigned) - 5} more)" if len(unassigned) > 5 else ""
                return PreFlightCheck(
                    name="materials",
                    description="Check for geometry prims without assigned materials",
                    severity=CheckSeverity.SOFT_WARN,
                    passed=False,
                    message=f"Found {len(unassigned)} prim(s) without materials: "
                            f"{paths}{suffix}. They'll render with the default grey shader.",
                )
            return PreFlightCheck(
                name="materials",
                description="Check for geometry prims without assigned materials",
                severity=CheckSeverity.SOFT_WARN,
                passed=True,
                message="All geometry prims have materials assigned.",
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            return PreFlightCheck(
                name="materials",
                description="Check for geometry prims without assigned materials",
                severity=CheckSeverity.SOFT_WARN,
                passed=False,
                message=f"Couldn't check material assignments: {exc}",
            )

    async def _check_render_settings(self, plan: RenderPlan) -> PreFlightCheck:
        """SOFT_WARN if render quality settings appear unusually low."""
        try:
            result = await self._handler.call("render_settings", {"action": "get"})
            pixel_samples = result.get("pixel_samples", 0)
            resolution_x = result.get("resolution_x", 0)

            warnings: List[str] = []
            if 0 < pixel_samples < 8:
                warnings.append(
                    f"Pixel samples is {pixel_samples} (very low — consider 32+ for production)"
                )
            if 0 < resolution_x < 320:
                warnings.append(
                    f"Resolution width is {resolution_x}px (very low for a final render)"
                )

            if warnings:
                return PreFlightCheck(
                    name="render_settings",
                    description="Warn if render quality settings are unusually low",
                    severity=CheckSeverity.SOFT_WARN,
                    passed=False,
                    message="; ".join(warnings),
                )
            return PreFlightCheck(
                name="render_settings",
                description="Warn if render quality settings are unusually low",
                severity=CheckSeverity.SOFT_WARN,
                passed=True,
                message="Render quality settings look reasonable.",
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            return PreFlightCheck(
                name="render_settings",
                description="Warn if render quality settings are unusually low",
                severity=CheckSeverity.SOFT_WARN,
                passed=False,
                message=f"Couldn't read render settings: {exc}",
            )

    async def _check_frame_range(self, plan: RenderPlan) -> PreFlightCheck:
        """HARD_FAIL if the planned frame range is invalid."""
        if plan.estimated_frames <= 0:
            return PreFlightCheck(
                name="frame_range",
                description="Verify frame range is valid and within scene bounds",
                severity=CheckSeverity.HARD_FAIL,
                passed=False,
                message="Couldn't determine any frames to render. "
                        "Check the intent — we need at least one frame.",
            )

        # Check against scene frame range if available
        try:
            result = await self._handler.call("get_scene_info", {})
            scene_start = result.get("frame_start", None)
            scene_end = result.get("frame_end", None)

            if scene_start is not None and scene_end is not None:
                # Extract planned range from steps
                planned_start = None
                planned_end = None
                for step in plan.steps:
                    if "start_frame" in step.params:
                        planned_start = step.params["start_frame"]
                    if "end_frame" in step.params:
                        planned_end = step.params["end_frame"]

                if planned_start is not None and planned_end is not None:
                    if planned_start > planned_end:
                        return PreFlightCheck(
                            name="frame_range",
                            description="Verify frame range is valid and within scene bounds",
                            severity=CheckSeverity.HARD_FAIL,
                            passed=False,
                            message=f"Start frame ({planned_start}) is after end frame "
                                    f"({planned_end}). That doesn't look right.",
                        )
        except Exception:
            pass  # Scene info unavailable — still pass on estimated_frames > 0

        return PreFlightCheck(
            name="frame_range",
            description="Verify frame range is valid and within scene bounds",
            severity=CheckSeverity.HARD_FAIL,
            passed=True,
            message=f"Frame range looks valid ({plan.estimated_frames} frame(s) planned).",
        )

    async def _check_output_path(self) -> PreFlightCheck:
        """SOFT_WARN if the render output directory doesn't exist."""
        try:
            result = await self._handler.call("render_settings", {"action": "get"})
            output_path = result.get("output_path", "") or result.get("picture", "")

            if not output_path:
                return PreFlightCheck(
                    name="output_path",
                    description="Check that the output directory exists or can be created",
                    severity=CheckSeverity.SOFT_WARN,
                    passed=False,
                    message="Couldn't find an output path configured. "
                            "Set the 'picture' parameter on the Karma LOP.",
                )
            return PreFlightCheck(
                name="output_path",
                description="Check that the output directory exists or can be created",
                severity=CheckSeverity.SOFT_WARN,
                passed=True,
                message=f"Output path configured: {output_path}",
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            return PreFlightCheck(
                name="output_path",
                description="Check that the output directory exists or can be created",
                severity=CheckSeverity.SOFT_WARN,
                passed=False,
                message=f"Couldn't verify output path: {exc}",
            )

    async def _check_solaris_ordering(self, plan: RenderPlan) -> PreFlightCheck:
        """Detect ambiguous LOP merge ordering via solaris_validate_ordering handler."""
        try:
            render_node = ""
            if plan.steps:
                render_node = plan.steps[0].params.get("render_node", "")
            result = await self._handler.call("solaris_validate_ordering", {
                "render_node": render_node
            })

            if result.get("clean", True):
                return PreFlightCheck(
                    name="solaris_ordering",
                    description="Solaris network ordering check",
                    severity=CheckSeverity.INFO,
                    passed=True,
                    message="No ordering ambiguities detected."
                )
            else:
                issues = result.get("issues", [])
                issue_desc = "; ".join(f"{i['node']}: {i['type']}" for i in issues)
                return PreFlightCheck(
                    name="solaris_ordering",
                    description="Solaris network ordering check",
                    severity=CheckSeverity.SOFT_WARN,
                    passed=False,
                    message=f"Ordering ambiguities detected: {issue_desc}. Review merge order before rendering."
                )
        except Exception as exc:
            return PreFlightCheck(
                name="solaris_ordering",
                description="Solaris network ordering check",
                severity=CheckSeverity.INFO,
                passed=True,
                message=f"Couldn't run ordering check: {exc}"
            )

    async def _check_missing_assets(self) -> PreFlightCheck:
        """SOFT_WARN if unresolved USD asset references are found."""
        try:
            result = await self._handler.call("get_stage_info", {})
            unresolved = result.get("unresolved_references", [])

            if unresolved:
                refs = ", ".join(str(r) for r in unresolved[:5])
                suffix = f" (and {len(unresolved) - 5} more)" if len(unresolved) > 5 else ""
                return PreFlightCheck(
                    name="missing_assets",
                    description="Check for unresolved USD asset references",
                    severity=CheckSeverity.SOFT_WARN,
                    passed=False,
                    message=f"Found {len(unresolved)} unresolved reference(s): "
                            f"{refs}{suffix}. These assets may render as missing geometry.",
                )
            return PreFlightCheck(
                name="missing_assets",
                description="Check for unresolved USD asset references",
                severity=CheckSeverity.SOFT_WARN,
                passed=True,
                message="All USD asset references resolved successfully.",
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            return PreFlightCheck(
                name="missing_assets",
                description="Check for unresolved USD asset references",
                severity=CheckSeverity.SOFT_WARN,
                passed=False,
                message=f"Couldn't check asset references: {exc}",
            )

"""
Synapse Autonomy Pipeline — Data Models

Shared data structures for the autonomous render loop:
Plan -> Validate -> Execute -> Evaluate -> Report.

All models are stdlib-only dataclasses with full type hints.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from enum import Enum
from typing import List, Optional, Dict, Any
from datetime import datetime


class GateLevel(Enum):
    """Approval requirement for an autonomous step.

    Mirrors core.gates.GateLevel but scoped to the autonomy pipeline
    to avoid tight coupling. Maps 1:1 when bridging to the gate system.
    """
    INFORM = "inform"
    REVIEW = "review"
    CONFIRM = "confirm"


class StepStatus(Enum):
    """Execution status of a single render step."""
    PENDING = "pending"
    RUNNING = "running"
    COMPLETED = "completed"
    FAILED = "failed"
    SKIPPED = "skipped"


class CheckSeverity(Enum):
    """How severely a pre-flight check failure affects the pipeline."""
    HARD_FAIL = "hard_fail"   # Blocks execution entirely
    SOFT_WARN = "soft_warn"   # Logs warning, continues
    INFO = "info"             # Informational only


@dataclass
class RenderStep:
    """A single step in a render plan, mapped to a handler call."""
    handler: str
    params: Dict[str, Any]
    description: str
    gate: GateLevel = GateLevel.INFORM
    status: StepStatus = StepStatus.PENDING
    result: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
    error: Optional[str] = None


@dataclass
class PreFlightCheck:
    """Result of a single pre-flight validation check."""
    name: str
    description: str
    severity: CheckSeverity
    passed: bool = False
    message: str = ""


@dataclass
class RenderPlan:
    """A complete render plan with steps and validation metadata."""
    intent: str
    steps: List[RenderStep] = field(default_factory=list)
    validation_checks: List[PreFlightCheck] = field(default_factory=list)
    estimated_frames: int = 0
    gate_level: GateLevel = GateLevel.REVIEW
    created_at: datetime = field(default_factory=datetime.now)


@dataclass
class FrameEvaluation:
    """Quality evaluation for a single rendered frame."""
    frame: int
    output_path: str
    passed: bool
    issues: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    metrics: Dict[str, float] = field(default_factory=dict)


@dataclass
class SequenceEvaluation:
    """Quality evaluation for an entire rendered sequence."""
    frame_evaluations: List[FrameEvaluation] = field(default_factory=list)
    temporal_issues: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    overall_score: float = 0.0
    passed: bool = False


@dataclass
class Decision:
    """A recorded decision made during the autonomous loop."""
    timestamp: datetime
    context: str
    decision: str
    reasoning: str
    gate_level: GateLevel


@dataclass
class RenderReport:
    """Final report from an autonomous render execution."""
    plan: RenderPlan
    evaluation: Optional[SequenceEvaluation] = None
    decisions: List[Decision] = field(default_factory=list)
    iterations: int = 0
    total_time_seconds: float = 0.0
    success: bool = False

1→"""
     2→Synapse Autonomy Pipeline — Autonomous Driver
     3→
     4→Orchestrates the full render loop: Plan -> Validate -> Execute -> Evaluate -> Report.
     5→Supports checkpoint/resume, decision logging, gate-based approval, and
     6→automatic re-planning on evaluation failure (up to max_iterations).
     7→"""
     8→
     9→import asyncio
    10→import json
    11→import logging
    12→import time
    13→from datetime import datetime
    14→from typing import Any, Callable, Dict, List, Optional, Protocol
    15→
    16→from .models import (
    17→    CheckSeverity,
    18→    Decision,
    19→    GateLevel,
    20→    RenderPlan,
    21→    RenderReport,
    22→    RenderStep,
    23→    SequenceEvaluation,
    24→    StepStatus,
    25→)
    26→from .planner import RenderPlanner
    27→from .validator import PreFlightValidator
    28→from .evaluator import RenderEvaluator
    29→
    30→logger = logging.getLogger("synapse.autonomy.driver")
    31→
    32→
    33→class HandlerInterface(Protocol):
    34→    """Async callable interface for executing MCP handler tools."""
    35→
    36→    async def call(self, tool_name: str, params: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    37→        """Call a handler tool by name with the given parameters."""
    38→        ...
    39→
    40→
    41→class MemorySystem(Protocol):
    42→    """Minimal interface for the Synapse memory system."""
    43→
    44→    def add(self, content: str, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
    45→        """Store a memory entry."""
    46→        ...
    47→
    48→
    49→class AutonomousDriver:
    50→    """Drives the full autonomous render loop.
    51→
    52→    Lifecycle per execution:
    53→        1. Plan: build a RenderPlan from artist intent
    54→        2. Gate: present plan for approval if gate level >= REVIEW
    55→        3. Validate: run pre-flight checks (HARD_FAIL stops, SOFT_WARN continues)
    56→        4. Execute: call render handler(s) via handler_interface
    57→        5. Evaluate: run quality checks on rendered output
    58→        6. Re-plan: if evaluation fails and iterations < max, loop back
    59→        7. Report: compile final RenderReport
    60→
    61→    Args:
    62→        planner: Builds and revises render plans.
    63→        validator: Runs pre-flight scene checks.
    64→        evaluator: Evaluates rendered output quality.
    65→        handler_interface: Async callable for MCP handler tools.
    66→        memory_system: For persisting decisions and context.
    67→        max_iterations: Maximum re-plan attempts before giving up.
    68→    """
    69→
    70→    def __init__(
    71→        self,
    72→        planner: RenderPlanner,
    73→        validator: PreFlightValidator,
    74→        evaluator: RenderEvaluator,
    75→        handler_interface: HandlerInterface,
    76→        memory_system: Optional[MemorySystem] = None,
    77→        max_iterations: int = 3,
    78→    ) -> None:
    79→        self._planner = planner
    80→        self._validator = validator
    81→        self._evaluator = evaluator
    82→        self._handler = handler_interface
    83→        self._memory = memory_system
    84→        self._max_iterations = max_iterations
    85→
    86→        self._decisions: List[Decision] = []
    87→        self._checkpoints: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
    88→        self._cancelled = False
    89→
    90→        # Approval callback — override for UI integration
    91→        self._approval_callback: Optional[Callable[[RenderPlan], bool]] = None
    92→
    93→    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    94→    # Public API
    95→    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    96→
    97→    async def execute(self, intent: str) -> RenderReport:
    98→        """Run the full autonomous render loop.
    99→
   100→        Args:
   101→            intent: Natural-language render intent from the artist.
   102→
   103→        Returns:
   104→            RenderReport with plan, evaluation, decisions, and success flag.
   105→        """
   106→        start_time = time.monotonic()
   107→        self._cancelled = False
   108→        self._decisions = []
   109→        iteration = 0
   110→        evaluation: Optional[SequenceEvaluation] = None
   111→
   112→        # Step 1: Plan
   113→        plan = self._planner.plan(intent)
   114→        self._log_decision(
   115→            context="initial_plan",
   116→            decision=f"Created render plan with {len(plan.steps)} step(s) "
   117→                     f"for {plan.estimated_frames} frame(s)",
   118→            reasoning=f"Parsed intent: '{intent}'",
   119→            gate=GateLevel.INFORM,
   120→        )
   121→        self._checkpoint("plan_created", {"plan_intent": plan.intent})
   122→
   123→        # Step 2: Gate check
   124→        if plan.gate_level in (GateLevel.REVIEW, GateLevel.CONFIRM):
   125→            approved = await self._present_for_approval(plan)
   126→            if not approved:
   127→                self._log_decision(
   128→                    context="gate_rejected",
   129→                    decision="Artist declined the render plan",
   130→                    reasoning="Plan was presented for approval and rejected",
   131→                    gate=plan.gate_level,
   132→                )
   133→                return RenderReport(
   134→                    plan=plan,
   135→                    decisions=list(self._decisions),
   136→                    iterations=0,
   137→                    total_time_seconds=time.monotonic() - start_time,
   138→                    success=False,
   139→                )
   140→
   141→        while iteration < self._max_iterations:
   142→            if self._cancelled:
   143→                self._log_decision(
   144→                    context="emergency_stop",
   145→                    decision="Render loop cancelled via emergency stop",
   146→                    reasoning="emergency_stop() was called during execution",
   147→                    gate=GateLevel.INFORM,
   148→                )
   149→                break
   150→
   151→            iteration += 1
   152→            self._checkpoint(f"iteration_{iteration}", {"iteration": iteration})
   153→
   154→            # Step 3: Validate
   155→            checks = await self._validator.validate(plan)
   156→            plan.validation_checks = checks
   157→
   158→            hard_fails = [c for c in checks if c.severity == CheckSeverity.HARD_FAIL and not c.passed]
   159→            soft_warns = [c for c in checks if c.severity == CheckSeverity.SOFT_WARN and not c.passed]
   160→
   161→            if hard_fails:
   162→                fail_names = ", ".join(c.name for c in hard_fails)
   163→                self._log_decision(
   164→                    context="validation_failed",
   165→                    decision=f"Stopping: {len(hard_fails)} hard failure(s): {fail_names}",
   166→                    reasoning="; ".join(c.message for c in hard_fails),
   167→                    gate=GateLevel.INFORM,
   168→                )
   169→                return RenderReport(
   170→                    plan=plan,
   171→                    decisions=list(self._decisions),
   172→                    iterations=iteration,
   173→                    total_time_seconds=time.monotonic() - start_time,
   174→                    success=False,
   175→                )
   176→
   177→            if soft_warns:
   178→                warn_names = ", ".join(c.name for c in soft_warns)
   179→                self._log_decision(
   180→                    context="validation_warnings",
   181→                    decision=f"Continuing with {len(soft_warns)} warning(s): {warn_names}",
   182→                    reasoning="Soft warnings don't block execution",
   183→                    gate=GateLevel.INFORM,
   184→                )
   185→
   186→            # Step 4: Execute render steps
   187→            execution_ok = await self._execute_steps(plan)
   188→            if not execution_ok:
   189→                self._log_decision(
   190→                    context="execution_failed",
   191→                    decision="One or more render steps failed",
   192→                    reasoning="Handler returned an error during execution",
   193→                    gate=GateLevel.INFORM,
   194→                )
   195→                if iteration < self._max_iterations:
   196→                    # Build a minimal evaluation so replan has something to work with
   197→                    if evaluation is None:
   198→                        evaluation = SequenceEvaluation(passed=False)
   199→                    plan = self._planner.replan(plan, evaluation)
   200→                    continue
   201→                break
   202→
   203→            # Step 5: Collect render results and evaluate
   204→            render_results = await self._collect_results(plan)
   205→            evaluation = self._evaluator.evaluate_sequence(render_results)
   206→
   207→            self._log_decision(
   208→                context="evaluation_complete",
   209→                decision=f"Sequence score: {evaluation.overall_score:.2f}, "
   210→                         f"passed: {evaluation.passed}",
   211→                reasoning=f"{len(evaluation.frame_evaluations)} frame(s) evaluated, "
   212→                          f"{len(evaluation.temporal_issues)} temporal issue(s)",
   213→                gate=GateLevel.INFORM,
   214→            )
   215→
   216→            # Step 6: Check if we need to re-plan
   217→            if evaluation.passed:
   218→                self._log_decision(
   219→                    context="render_success",
   220→                    decision="Render sequence passed quality checks",
   221→                    reasoning=f"Overall score {evaluation.overall_score:.2f} >= 0.7 threshold",
   222→                    gate=GateLevel.INFORM,
   223→                )
   224→                break
   225→
   226→            if iteration < self._max_iterations:
   227→                self._log_decision(
   228→                    context="replan",
   229→                    decision=f"Re-planning (iteration {iteration}/{self._max_iterations})",
   230→                    reasoning="Evaluation failed — adjusting settings and re-rendering failed frames",
   231→                    gate=GateLevel.INFORM,
   232→                )
   233→                plan = self._planner.replan(plan, evaluation)
   234→            else:
   235→                self._log_decision(
   236→                    context="max_iterations",
   237→                    decision=f"Giving up after {self._max_iterations} iteration(s)",
   238→                    reasoning="Max iteration limit reached without passing quality checks",
   239→                    gate=GateLevel.INFORM,
   240→                )
   241→
   242→        total_time = time.monotonic() - start_time
   243→
   244→        # Step 7: Compile report
   245→        report = RenderReport(
   246→            plan=plan,
   247→            evaluation=evaluation,
   248→            decisions=list(self._decisions),
   249→            iterations=iteration,
   250→            total_time_seconds=total_time,
   251→            success=evaluation.passed if evaluation else False,
   252→        )
   253→
   254→        # Persist to memory
   255→        if self._memory:
   256→            try:
   257→                self._memory.add(
   258→                    content=f"Autonomous render: '{intent}' - "
   259→                            f"{'succeeded' if report.success else 'failed'} "
   260→                            f"after {iteration} iteration(s) in {total_time:.1f}s",
   261→                    type="decision",
   262→                    tags=["autonomy", "render"],
   263→                )
   264→            except Exception:
   265→                logger.warning("Couldn't persist render report to memory")
   266→
   267→        return report
   268→
   269→    def emergency_stop(self) -> None:
   270→        """Cancel the current render loop at the next checkpoint.
   271→
   272→        Also attempts to cancel any active TOPS work items via the
   273→        handler interface.
   274→        """
   275→        self._cancelled = True
   276→        self._log_decision(
   277→            context="emergency_stop_requested",
   278→            decision="Emergency stop requested by artist",
   279→            reasoning="Artist triggered emergency stop",
   280→            gate=GateLevel.INFORM,
   281→        )
   282→        logger.warning("Emergency stop requested — render loop will halt at next checkpoint")
   283→
   284→    def set_approval_callback(self, callback: Callable[[RenderPlan], bool]) -> None:
   285→        """Set a callback for gate approval prompts.
   286→
   287→        The callback receives a RenderPlan and returns True to approve,
   288→        False to reject. If no callback is set, plans at REVIEW level
   289→        are auto-approved and CONFIRM level plans are auto-rejected.
   290→        """
   291→        self._approval_callback = callback
   292→
   293→    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
   294→    # Internal: execution
   295→    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
   296→
   297→    async def _execute_steps(self, plan: RenderPlan) -> bool:
   298→        """Execute all steps in the plan sequentially.
   299→
   300→        Returns True if all steps completed, False if any failed.
   301→        """
   302→        for step in plan.steps:
   303→            if self._cancelled:
   304→                step.status = StepStatus.SKIPPED
   305→                continue
   306→
   307→            step.status = StepStatus.RUNNING
   308→            try:
   309→                result = await self._handler.call(step.handler, step.params)
   310→                step.result = result
   311→                step.status = StepStatus.COMPLETED
   312→            except Exception as exc:
   313→                step.error = str(exc)
   314→                step.status = StepStatus.FAILED
   315→                logger.error(
   316→                    "Step '%s' failed: %s", step.description, exc
   317→                )
   318→                return False
   319→
   320→        return True
   321→
   322→    async def _collect_results(
   323→        self,
   324→        plan: RenderPlan,
   325→    ) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
   326→        """Collect rendered frame data for evaluation.
   327→
   328→        Queries the handler_interface for render output paths and
   329→        optionally loads image data if available.
   330→        """
   331→        results: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
   332→
   333→        # Find the render step to get frame range
   334→        render_step = None
   335→        for step in plan.steps:
   336→            if step.handler in ("render_sequence", "render"):
   337→                render_step = step
   338→                break
   339→
   340→        if render_step is None or render_step.result is None:
   341→            return results
   342→
   343→        # Extract output info from render result
   344→        output_frames = render_step.result.get("frames", [])
   345→        if isinstance(output_frames, list):
   346→            for frame_info in output_frames:
   347→                if isinstance(frame_info, dict):
   348→                    results.append({
   349→                        "frame": frame_info.get("frame", 0),
   350→                        "output_path": frame_info.get("output_path", ""),
   351→                        "image_data": frame_info.get("image_data"),
   352→                    })
   353→                elif isinstance(frame_info, (int, float)):
   354→                    results.append({
   355→                        "frame": int(frame_info),
   356→                        "output_path": render_step.result.get("output_dir", ""),
   357→                        "image_data": None,
   358→                    })
   359→
   360→        # If no structured frame data, build from step params
   361→        if not results and render_step.result:
   362→            start = render_step.params.get("start_frame", 1)
   363→            end = render_step.params.get("end_frame", start)
   364→            output_dir = render_step.result.get("output_dir", "")
   365→            for f in range(start, end + 1):
   366→                results.append({
   367→                    "frame": f,
   368→                    "output_path": output_dir,
   369→                    "image_data": None,
   370→                })
   371→
   372→        return results
   373→
   374→    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
   375→    # Internal: gate system
   376→    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
   377→
   378→    async def _present_for_approval(self, plan: RenderPlan) -> bool:
   379→        """Present a plan for artist approval.
   380→
   381→        Uses the registered approval callback if available. Otherwise:
   382→        - REVIEW plans are auto-approved (artist trusts the system)
   383→        - CONFIRM plans are auto-rejected (too risky without explicit approval)
   384→        """

   386→            try:
   387→                return self._approval_callback(plan)
   388→            except Exception as exc:
   389→                logger.error("Approval callback raised an error: %s", exc)
   390→                return False
   391→
   392→        # Default policy
   393→        if plan.gate_level == GateLevel.REVIEW:
   394→            self._log_decision(
   395→                context="auto_approve",
   396→                decision="Auto-approved REVIEW-level plan (no approval callback set)",
   397→                reasoning="Default policy: REVIEW plans proceed without explicit approval",
   398→                gate=GateLevel.REVIEW,
   399→            )
   400→            return True
   401→
   402→        # CONFIRM requires explicit approval
   403→        self._log_decision(
   404→            context="auto_reject",
   405→            decision="Auto-rejected CONFIRM-level plan (no approval callback set)",
   406→            reasoning="Default policy: CONFIRM plans require an explicit approval callback",
   407→            gate=GateLevel.CONFIRM,
   408→        )
   409→        return False
